stage0064_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「See ya, $$宗介$$.
　I'm heading back to Japan with $$甲児$$ and the others.」

stage0064_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll remain on duty as I am.
　$$甲児$$ and the others have their own work in Japan,
　so you'll need to protect yourself.」

stage0064_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$宗介$$
「That being the case, I'll give you this.」

stage0064_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Such pretty earrings...
　When did you buy these?」

stage0064_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm embarrassed to say, I made them myself.」

stage0064_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$宗介$$
「Explosives this small aren't sold commercially.」

stage0064_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$宗介$$
「But, rest assured.
　I guarantee its effect.」

stage0064_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$宗介$$
「In an emergency, take it off your ear,
　close your eyes, and throw it at them...」

stage0064_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...I feel like causing that emergency right now!」

stage0064_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$宗介$$
「S-sorry...!
　It seems I've made some awful mistake...」

stage0064_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Never mind...
　We won't see each other for a while,
　so it'd be silly to part on bad terms.」

stage0064_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, thanks for the earrings.
　I'll keep them somewhere safe.」

stage0064_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Come back safe, $$宗介$$.
　Summer vacation's almost over, though.」

stage0064_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$宗介$$
「I intend to.
　I want to proudly turn in the homework
　the Volunteer Club did together.」

stage0064_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Very well.
　...When you're back, I'll make $$宗介$$'s favorite.」

stage0064_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カレン$$
「Is this okay, $$テッサ$$?
　Those two seem to be getting pretty close...」

stage0064_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Ah... you'll be with us for a while now,
　is that where that composure comes from?」

stage0064_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...We'll see each other again, right?」

stage0064_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　I will return alive, without fail.」

stage0064_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Distance apart, but our hearts as one, huh?
　Ah, youth.」

stage0064_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Steamy, huh...
　And summer's almost over too.」

stage0064_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$宗介$$
「The $$プトレマイオス２改$$'s AC is perfect, though.」

stage0064_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Is that a joke? Or are you just clueless?」

stage0064_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's just how he is.
　Now you see what I deal with daily?」

stage0064_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Can you say that line in front of us,
　who've fought alongside this crowd?」

stage0064_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「...Sorry.
　I didn't know any better.」

stage0064_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's all good.
　You've more than earned the right, you know?」

stage0064_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The right...?
　What's that supposed to mean?」

stage0064_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Thanks to my memories coming back,
　I remembered stuff I didn't want to...
　Point is, you're in the same group as us.」

stage0064_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「As for that,
　once we link up with $$青山$$ and our ace,
　I'll fill you in on all of it.」

stage0064_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You're probably the reason! Don't you dare say that!」

stage0064_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　With homework done, nothing hinders the mission.」

stage0064_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Do you have a moment, Sergeant Sagara?」

stage0064_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I asked Captain $$スメラギ$$ to prepare a room.
　Let's talk there.」

stage0064_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$クルツ$$
「'No problem,' my ass.
　Don't even think about two-timing
　just 'cause $$かなめ$$'s not around.」

stage0064_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now then, let's go, Sergeant Sagara.」

stage0064_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「That surprised me.
　That presence... she's no ordinary pretty girl.」

stage0064_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's rare.
　$$テッサ$$ acting like that outside of combat command...」

stage0064_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Do you know something, $$カレン$$?」

stage0064_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「I don't know, but I feel something's moving...」

stage0064_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems this new mission will open with turmoil.」

stage0064_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0064_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now then, I'll read the order Joint
　Operations Command issued to $$ウルズ$$ 7.」

stage0064_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宗介$$
（Command HQ...?
　From above the Danaan...）

stage0064_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Top priority order 05J005-3128. 191121Z,
　West Pacific Fleet HQ, Joint Operations Command...」

stage0064_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Current priority order 05E001-3128...
　has decided to rescind the $$千鳥かなめ$$
　escort mission, effective 1500 hours today.」

stage0064_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「From now on, $$ウルズ$$ 7 is forbidden from
　contacting $$千鳥かなめ$$. Her escort will
　now be fully handled by codename '$$レイス$$'.」

stage0064_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's already decided.
　Since it's past 1500, the order is already in effect.」

stage0064_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's absurd...!
　Are you saying I'm at fault!?」

stage0064_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You have a critical duty:
　operating the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$.」

stage0064_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As you already know, operating a Lambda
　Driver-equipped unit carries great weight
　in the fight between $$ミスリル$$ and Amalgam.」

stage0064_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As it stands, you're the only one here
　who can operate that unit.」

stage0064_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「From now on, her escort goes to Intelligence,
　and you'll focus on mastering that unit.」

stage0064_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The codename is '$$レイス$$'...
　That's all I know as well.」

stage0064_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「However, I hear that person
　has been secretly guarding $$かなめ$$
　alongside you, all this time.」

stage0064_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then there's a problem.
　She's been in danger many times.」

stage0064_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
「Isn't that proof that this so-called
　'$$レイス$$' has been utterly useless...!」

stage0064_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$テッサ$$
「On that point, you do have a fair argument.
　But this is a decision made by Command HQ.」

stage0064_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Yes, that's right!
　If that convinces you, I'll make it an order!」

stage0064_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if it means
　taking you away from $$かなめ$$!」

stage0064_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Must be nice, being so carefree!
　As long as you can resent me, it distracts you...!」

stage0064_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But I have to think about my subordinates'
　safety! You know Amalgam's power, don't you?
　They're deploying Lambda Drivers in combat!」

stage0064_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That power is a threat!
　This time, Melissa might really die...!
　Or maybe Weber...!」

stage0064_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Do you even understand how I feel
　every time I sit in the captain's chair!?」

stage0064_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What are you even looking at?
　Is she the only thing on your mind?
　Have you thought about my feelings at all?」

stage0064_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You're the worst!
　You act obedient and kind,
　but you're really a terrible egoist!」

stage0064_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And you lie to yourself, too!
　Why don't you just say it plainly...!
　'I want to be with that girl! Don't interfere!'」

stage0064_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It would be so much easier... if you'd just say that...」

stage0064_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I hate how you always apologize like that, too.」

stage0064_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There's nothing more to say.
　Dismissed.」

stage0064_03:r_b025267f22788233.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0064_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「...That's everything I found on Amalgam
　using $$ヴェーダ$$.」

stage0064_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Good work, $$ティエリア$$.
　Sorry for the meeting right after you got back.」

stage0064_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「No... Amalgam, which is allied with Geminis,
　is arguably one of the biggest threats now.」

stage0064_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But we got less out of this than I expected.」

stage0064_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A power skilled enough to conceal itself
　that well... A fearsome thing indeed.」

stage0064_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In that regard, it's the same as Chrono.」

stage0064_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「For one of their members
　to reveal Amalgam's name to Captain Testarossa
　can only be taken as provocation.」

stage0064_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Where is that Captain Testarossa now?
　I heard she's aboard the Ptolemy.」

stage0064_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「She's not feeling well right now.
　We'll hold the pre-briefing without her.」

stage0064_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Heh... Before, you would have
　complained about her lack of self-care.
　You've changed.」

stage0064_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I don't want to hear that from you, $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0064_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But that's $$ヴェーダ$$ and $$ティエリア$$ for you.
　Pinpointing where Amalgam is active
　from so little information.」

stage0064_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So in this $$ヘルマジスタン$$, they've sent
　forces in, posing as support for rebels...」

stage0064_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Consider it a field test for a new unit.」

stage0064_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In other words, a Lambda Driver model.」

stage0064_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「First, we send a recon team to scout
　the area. I've already picked the best people.」

stage0064_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's someone with ties to this land.」

stage0064_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Depending on the situation, I'll move
　the troops and wipe them out in one go.」

stage0064_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ティエリア$$...
　Is that Gundam you brought usable?」

stage0064_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Unfortunately, it's still being adjusted.
　I only used it as transport this time.」

stage0064_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Well, fine.
　As long as we hold the terrain, we have a chance.」

stage0064_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「After all, we have myself, Miss $$スメラギ$$...
　plus Captain Testarossa.」

stage0064_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Since this was unconfirmed information,
　I chose not to report it, but...」

stage0064_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems $$張五飛$$ is among Amalgam's forces.」

stage0064_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「There's a town 10km to the south.
　Amalgam's target is its defense force.」

stage0064_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「$$ヘルマジスタン$$'s government forces can't
　stop them. We should strike first ourselves.」

stage0064_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$スザク$$
「I agree.
　I'm sure $$ゼロ$$ and $$スメラギ$$ would call it too.」

stage0064_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$n
「I heard from $$マオ$$ that you're off Chidori duty.
　You've got feelings, but focus on the mission.」

stage0064_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$スザク$$
「I'm counting on you.
　You were picked for the recon team
　for knowing this terrain so well.」

stage0064_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's pointless to expect much from him now.
　I'll guide the way.」

stage0064_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I was once on a mission near here.
　A long time ago... back when I'd just
　started my training as an agent.」

stage0064_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$スザク$$
「Nearly 10 years ago, there was a
　charismatic leader among the guerrillas
　trying to overthrow this country's government.」

stage0064_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$スザク$$
「He was a nationalist who hated foreign capital,
　so I hear he backed the colony liberation movement.」

stage0064_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$刹那$$
「His name was Majid...
　Known as 'the Tiger of Badakhshan'.」

stage0064_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$刹那$$
「...This was before I joined Celestial Being.
　I once came to this country to assassinate him.」

stage0064_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$刹那$$
「If Majid pushed foreign capital out of
　$$ヘルマジスタン$$, those countries probably thought
　they'd target neighboring 《$$クルジス$$》 next.」

stage0064_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$刹那$$
「Back then, the 《$$ＫＰＳＡ$$》 I belonged to
　sent an assassination squad to remove him.
　I was one of them.」

stage0064_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$n
「$$刹那$$ has a past like that...」

stage0064_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$刹那$$
「Though back then I was just a boy soldier,
　good for nothing but a shield or decoy.」

stage0064_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Majid's existence wasn't a problem
　only for that $$ＫＰＳＡ$$.」

stage0064_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$宗介$$
「Other groups were after him too,
　and fighting between them was just
　routine here in $$ヘルマジスタン$$.」

stage0064_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$宗介$$
「And I was a member of one of those groups.」

stage0064_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$n
「So $$ヒイロ$$, $$刹那$$, and $$宗介$$ might
　have fought as enemies, long ago.」

stage0064_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$スザク$$
「And yet here you are, fighting together now.」

stage0064_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$スザク$$
（No wonder they call you
　$c's Silent Five.）

stage0064_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$n
（$$宗介$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$刹那$$...
　If $$キリコ$$ joins them, who's the last one?）

stage0064_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$スザク$$
（I think it's better you don't know.）

stage0064_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$刹那$$
「...I don't intend to keep wearing that nickname.」

stage0064_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'm going to change...
　I have to change.」

stage0064_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$n
「You... Were you after that man
　called Majid this whole time?」

stage0064_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$宗介$$
「No...
　He was merciful. He treated me,
　his prisoner, like family.」

stage0064_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$宗介$$
「After that, I took the name 'Kashim' he gave me,
　and lived here in $$ヘルマジスタン$$ for years.」

stage0064_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$スザク$$
「Then this place is like a second home to you.」

stage0064_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$宗介$$
「...I don't really know where I was born...」

stage0064_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$n
「So this isn't a second home, it's your home.」

stage0064_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$宗介$$
（That's right...
　Here I learned to live... to fight...）

stage0064_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$スザク$$
「And now... you're caught in doubt...」

stage0064_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$五飛$$
「It's the same as you and $$ゼロ$$
　joining $c.」

stage0064_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$n
「$$張五飛$$...
　A Gundam pilot turned enemy...!」

stage0064_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't misunderstand.
　This is what happens when you turn on the world.」

stage0064_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$五飛$$...
　Why show yourself before us now?」

stage0064_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$五飛$$
「Call it a declaration of war.」

stage0064_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$スザク$$
「Stop it, $$五飛$$!
　Do you even know what's happening
　to the world right now!?」

stage0064_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$, huh...
　I've left that to $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0064_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$五飛$$
「I'll fight to change this world
　my own way, that's all.」

stage0064_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... and $c!
　Anyone who stands in my way is my enemy!」

stage0064_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$五飛$$
「A21 found their own path too...」

stage0064_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...We've ended up completely on the back foot.」

stage0064_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems we're in Amalgam's palm.」

stage0064_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Seems we underestimated the enemy.
　Organization, intel gathering... tactics...
　all of it far exceeds what we expected.」

stage0064_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$テッサ$$
（An opponent I can never beat, no matter what...
　This feeling... I've known it since I was young...）

stage0064_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Amalgam has a $$ウィスパード$$ too, of all things...）

stage0064_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm fine, Captain $$スメラギ$$.
　As commander, I have no time to be discouraged.」

stage0064_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Also, right now I'm serving as an advisor,
　so the title of captain doesn't suit me.
　Please, call me $$テッサ$$.」

stage0064_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Orders for our next operation should arrive
　from $$ミスリル$$ headquarters shortly.
　Let's decide our next move once they do.」

stage0064_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「The problem is him, isn't it...」

stage0064_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Putting all our intel together, we've concluded
　today's enemy commander is someone $$宗介$$ has
　known since childhood, an old friend.」

stage0064_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「The shocks just keep coming...」

stage0064_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Come on, man.
　His Lambda Driver is vital combat strength.」

stage0064_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I just hope things don't get any worse...」

stage0064_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$カレン$$
「...Why can't we just contact $$かなめ$$?」

stage0064_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$n
「I think this is $$宗介$$'s own fight to settle.」

stage0064_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カレン$$
「But I bet $$かなめ$$ is anxious, having every
　trace of $$宗介$$ vanish from her life so suddenly.」

stage0064_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「But what good would telling her the truth do now?」

stage0064_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$n
「...There's nothing we can do.
　Not for Chidori, and not for $$宗介$$ either.」

stage0064_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$カレン$$
「So you're saying we leave it all to $$宗介$$?
　What a beautiful bond of manly friendship.」

stage0064_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$カレン$$
「But I've got my own bond with $$かなめ$$.
　I'll do this my way, whether you like it or not.」

stage0064_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$カレン$$
「...This won't end with $$かなめ$$ in tears, right?」

stage0064_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$カレン$$
「...Fine.
　This time, I'll put our friendship first.」

stage0064_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カレン$$
「But if this goes wrong,
　I'm cutting that hair of yours.」

stage0064_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$甲児$$
「The volunteer club's activities sometimes
　take them somewhere with no signal.」

stage0064_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$恭子$$
「Sagara, Saotome, and the others...
　At this rate, they won't make it to the ceremony.」

stage0064_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$さやか$$
「It's all right, Kyoko.
　Miss $$スズネ$$ is with them, so they'll be
　marked present properly.」

stage0064_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah... you're right.
　Yeah... there's nothing to worry about.」

stage0064_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right.
　I'm sure he'll give us another one of his
　famously clueless reunions.」

stage0064_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$かなめ$$
（That's right, $$宗介$$...
　Nothing's happened, I'm sure...）

stage0064_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$カレン$$
「That girl, $$セイナ$$... I wonder what she'll do now...」

stage0064_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「She lives by her own will and fights by her
　own will. That's not ours to interfere with anymore.」

stage0064_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you have a justice within you that you won't
　yield, you mustn't back down. That's how you've lived.」

stage0064_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's exactly why you and they fought,
　and why they were able to find their own path.
　To regret that denies both yourself and them.」

stage0064_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$カレン$$
「...Thanks, $$ゼロ$$.
　That's put my mind a bit at ease.」

stage0064_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Marvelous! Bravo!
　As expected, the silver-tongued wizard, Master $$ゼロ$$!
　Ah, black really does suit the smooth talkers.」

stage0064_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$ would take offense if he heard that.」

stage0064_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... let's keep this between us.
　Master $$ロジャー$$ aside, I'd rather not have
　Master $$ドロシー#240$$ glaring at me.」

stage0064_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$カレン$$
「As glib as ever, that robot.」

stage0064_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Some welcome news for Master $$カレン$$.
　The Z-Chips prove that what Master $$ゼロ$$
　said just now was no lie.」

stage0064_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The woman who fought Master $$カレン$$ and Master
　$$ゼロ$$ produced Z-Chips out of satisfaction.
　The total: 100 Z!」

stage0064_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0064_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I don't know if she'll keep working with
　Amalgam as she has, but her heart is no
　longer a prisoner of the past.」

stage0064_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$カレン$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...!
　I'm going to go call $$赤木$$!」

stage0064_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「My thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　This should shake $$カレン$$ free of her doubts.」

stage0064_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're most welcome.
　It's an honor to be of use to Master $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0064_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Somehow, I feel a certain kinship with Master $$ゼロ$$...」

stage0064_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've been expecting you, Masters $$ティエリア$$, $$アレルヤ$$!」

stage0064_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$刹那$$.」

stage0064_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Getting right to it, Master $$ティエリア$$...
　Might I too be granted access to the
　famed $$ヴェーダ$$?」

stage0064_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are a number of things about this
　world I'd like to look into myself.」

stage0064_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm sorry, but that I cannot do.」

stage0064_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You don't trust me, is that it?」

stage0064_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「To be frank, yes, that's exactly it.」

stage0064_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Can't blame him, given your reputation.」

stage0064_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ngh...
　Then, Master $$アレルヤ$$!
　Please let me study you!」

stage0064_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes!
　I wish to meet Master $$ハレルヤ$$ within you!」

stage0064_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! Thank you for such a prompt appearance!」

stage0064_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Let me be clear, I've got no interest
　in cooperating with your research.」

stage0064_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「...All right.
　But just this once.」

stage0064_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go, then!
　Let's get fired up today too!」

stage0064_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$マリー$$
「Hehe... Both $$アレルヤ$$ and $$ハレルヤ$$ alike...」
